title: Diffusion TV: Experiencing Diffusion Models through Tangible, Embodied Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2609.05404v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion TV is an interactive AI art installation that offers a tangible and embodied experience of diffusion models through a modified CRT TV. By physically manipulating the TV's antenna, audiences control the clarity of AI-generated images and sounds, metaphorically enacting the denoising process that underlies diffusion-based generation. Using the tuning knob, participants switch between three channels featuring AI-generated animals from the Past (extinct species), Present (endangered species), and Future (speculative creatures), situating the interaction within a temporal and ecological narrative. Through continuous audiovisual feedback and physical interaction, Diffusion TV foregrounds the generative process over final outputs, allowing audiences to explore intermediate states as experiential material. translated_title: 扩散电视：通过实体化、具身化交互体验扩散模型
translated_abstract: 扩散电视是一件交互式AI艺术装置，通过一台经过改装的CRT电视，为观众提供对扩散模型的实体化与具身化体验。通过物理操纵电视天线，观众可以控制AI生成图像和声音的清晰度，隐喻性地演绎了扩散生成技术底层的去噪过程。利用调谐旋钮，参与者可以在三个频道之间切换，分别展示AI生成的过去（已灭绝物种）、现在（濒危物种）和未来（想象中的推测性生物）的动物，从而将交互置于一个时间与生态的叙事框架之中。通过持续的视听反馈和物理交互，扩散电视将生成过程本身置于最终输出之上，让观众得以把中间状态当作体验材料加以探索。该作品并不提供显式的技术讲解，而是呈现了一种另类的、具身化的可解释AI模式。
tldr: 该论文提出“扩散电视”交互式AI艺术装置，观众通过转动天线和旋钮控制AI生成内容清晰度，以具身化方式隐喻扩散模型的去噪过程，提供了一种可解释AI的另类体验模式。
en_tdlr: Diffusion TV is an interactive AI art installation where audiences manipulate a modified CRT TV's antenna to control the clarity of AI-generated media, tangibly and metaphorically embodying the denoising process of diffusion models as an alternative, embodied mode of explainable AI.
